title: A reflective infographic exploring why lasting healing requires more than intellectual understanding. This piece examines somatic integration, felt safety, nervous system regulation, and the process of moving insight from the mind into lived experience. A reminder that transformation becomes stable not when you understand it, but when your body learns it is safe enough to live it. #embodiment #somatic-healing #nervous-system #self-awareness #emotional-regulation
